name: REXX
reason: Both exact catalog versions group ARexx under a REXX classifier. The original addition included the arexx alias and all four specimens. The exact samples include a PPaint port, Amiga-specific paths and ARexx options; the pinned row also recognizes broader REXX suffixes and the Regina and rexx interpreter names. The historical language and this implementation are each supported separately. The classifier as a whole does not establish precise equivalence with one entity.
